name: gizza-ai/code-language-detect
summary: Detect a code snippet's programming language with explainable heuristics.

tool.description: Detect the likely programming language of a pasted source-code snippet using deterministic weighted signals, optional filename/shebang hints, a common-language filter, ranked alternatives, confidence, and evidence. Runs locally with no network or ML model.

candidates.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of language ids to consider, such as rust,python,javascript. Leave empty to consider every built-in language.

code.description: The source-code snippet to identify. Paste at least three to five lines for the most reliable result.

common_only.description: Only consider common mainstream languages. Useful for short snippets where niche-language signals can otherwise win.

explain.description: Include the weighted signals that explain the top detection.

filename.description: Optional filename hint such as main.rs, Dockerfile, package.json, or styles.css. Extensions and special filenames add a strong score bonus.

output.description: Output format: readable report, structured JSON, or just the top language id.

top_k.description: Number of ranked candidate languages to show. Use 0 to list every language with a positive score.
